title: Parul University announces Law Conclave & Gavel Glory Awards, 2026
description: Parul University, a NAAC A++ accredited institution committed to academic excellence and innovation, in association with Gavel Glory, has announced the Law Conclave 2026, a gathering of judicial luminaries, legal professionals, academicians, policymakers, corporate leaders, researchers, and aspiring lawyers from across the country.
